historical.summary: On 3 October 1990, the German Democratic Republic joined the Federal Republic of Germany under the accession process agreed in 1990, bringing German reunification into effect.

satire.publicSummary: The administrative merger is complete. Reconciling the filing systems has been assigned to a working group.
